info.title: hydromart-digital auth for the AI web and machine accounts
info.description: HD-3. How the AI web (a person) and n8n (a machine account) get ES256 tokens, and where the keys to verify them are. Tokens: iss hydromart-auth, aud hydromart-ai (carries the person's role) or hydromart-machine (carries scopes, a closed capability list), exp 15 minutes, kid in the header. An empty key set means AI and machine access is switched off. Sign-in: the AI web sends the person to the hydromart-digital web with a PKCE S256 challenge and a state; that page, under the person's own session, asks auth-service (POST auth/handoff/code) for a 60-second one-time code and returns it to the AI web callback; the AI web server then calls handoff/token below. The hydromart-digital page is not built yet (it comes with AI-3). HD-4: Direksi, HQ, Finance and SUPER_ADMIN, and anyone else who set up an authenticator, pass a second factor at handoff/token: the 6-digit code from their authenticator app (totp), a one-time recoveryCode, or the secondFactorTicket an earlier exchange returned. A ticket lasts 12 hours, so the person types a code once per session and the automatic re-handoffs send the ticket. The authenticator is set up in the hydromart-digital web, never in the AI web.

get.summary: Public keys (P-256, by kid). Empty = switched off.

post.summary: Called by the AI web's server: trade the code and the PKCE verifier for a 15-minute token. The code is spent on first use, right verifier or wrong, with one exception: when only the second factor is missing (401 AUTH_TOTP_REQUIRED) it is kept once, for 60 more seconds, so the AI web can ask for the code and present the same code and verifier again.

401.description: AUTH_HANDOFF_INVALID: unknown, used or expired code, or the wrong verifier: start again. AUTH_TOTP_REQUIRED: only the second factor is missing: ask the person and send the same code and verifier again with totp or recoveryCode within 60 seconds.

403.description: AUTH_TOTP_ENROLMENT_REQUIRED: this person must set up an authenticator in the hydromart-digital web first. AUTH_HANDOFF_STAFF_ONLY: a customer account.

422.description: AUTH_TOTP_INVALID: a wrong or used code. The handoff code is spent: start again.

429.description: AUTH_TOTP_LOCKED: five wrong codes in a row. details.retryAfterSeconds says how long.

503.description: AUTH_EXTERNAL_TOKENS_OFF: switched off. AUTH_TOTP_OFF: the server has no authenticator key and this person needs one.

post.summary: Called by n8n: trade a machine account id and secret for a 15-minute token carrying its scopes.

401.description: Unknown account, wrong secret, or a secret past its day

secondFactorTicket.description: Only after a totp or recoveryCode. Keep it server-side; send it on the next handoffs.
